study.question: Does supplied history order improve full-population validation click AUC beyond the complete unordered multiset of valid historical events and their task memberships under the frozen training protocol, with justified measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The imported incumbent uses contiguous ten-event compression and within-block, coarse-linear and quadratic positional summaries. Its improvement over DIN does not attribute value to order. If supplied order adds useful information conditional on event contents, counts and memberships, a matched supplied-order model should outperform both effective joint-shuffle retraining and a parameter-identical complete-event canonical-order replacement. Evaluation-only sensitivity is a separate distribution-shift diagnostic. No timestamps or elapsed-time effects are inferred; no novelty is claimed.

nearest_work.difference: Local nearest model and all learned components are inherited. Only a complete-event ordering adapter before embedding/compression/moment construction is added; context-gradient surrogate, modules, private losses and all optimization rules stay fixed.

Archived primary text describes target-conditioned weighted pooling (lines 80-85) and reports an unsuccessful LSTM attempt (278-283) on its own setting. baseline_reference.py is a local four-task/action adaptation. That historical negative result is external evidence, not a local refutation. This study tests supplied order in the stronger imported model rather than claiming a new pooling method.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 175-200 flatten the supplied item sequence before unified tokenization and interaction. This is a nearby order-exposing unified representation, not original-author reproduction evidence. We isolate supplied-order utility in the incumbent with complete-event transformations and unchanged parameter count; we do not implement or compare UniMixer performance.

inherited_components: Entire incumbent source architecture, including embeddings, action-aware target scorer, ten-block compression, five summary channels, four towers and task-specific residual/product adapters
All custom autograd/context-transfer helpers, source/gradient gates, four-task joint BCE hook and Dice state/update paths
Frozen protocol and input/scoring boundary; DIN and incumbent accepted validation receipts
study.proposed_difference: Four standalone variants share byte-identical backbone class bodies and intervention helper code; only literal architecture CONFIG differs. A get_inputs override jointly reorders every historical item/action field and all four task-mask memberships before any backbone operation. Random order uses a local torch.Generator, preserving host RNG. Canonical order lexicographically sorts every supplied item/action value and all task memberships, ignores original valid positions, and restores results into the original validity pattern. Equal canonical keys are identical complete events. No fields, events, trainable modules, state-dict tensors, labels or training exposure are added or removed.
predictions: Effective shuffling changes a high fraction of distinguishable event placements for histories longer than one while exactly preserving complete-event tuples, all task totals, target values, padding and validity. Empty/single-event inputs are unchanged.

For fixed learned state in eval mode, canonicalization produces identical complete tensors and predictions after arbitrary joint permutation of valid complete events, including noncontiguous masks and duplicate tuples.

Supplied-order and eval-only-shuffle arms have identical train-mode outputs, gradients, state updates and final checkpoint tensors under the same host seed; their evaluation difference measures sensitivity only.

Useful supplied-order evidence requires supplied-order click AUC exceeding BOTH retrained shuffle and canonical replacement by a predeclared practical margin of 0.0005, followed by authorized paired repetitions/intervals. One seed only supplies preliminary observations.

Parameter counts and state-dict tensor shapes match the incumbent (expected 32192421 total); runtime may increase from random priorities and repeated stable sorts and must be measured, not called free.
falsifiers: Any changed target/padding/validity, broken event-field/mask association, unequal parameterization or ineffective order manipulation invalidates the contrast before performance interpretation.
Dependence of canonicalized tensors or eval predictions on a joint permutation of distinguishable complete events falsifies the claimed order invariance.

No reproducible practical disadvantage for either effective matched order-removal method provides no support for useful supplied order in this backbone/recipe. A paired confidence interval wholly within +/-0.0005 supports practical equivalence; one near-zero point estimate does not.
An eval-only AUC drop that disappears with shuffle retraining or canonical replacement falsifies interpreting that drop alone as useful order information.
A shuffle/canonical gain is evidence against the supplied-order advantage, but cannot by itself identify regularization, content grouping or optimization as its cause.
alternative_explanations: Block composition and Dice running moments necessarily change with order removal; eval-only changes may reflect distribution shift.
Inherited batch-global surrogate context VJP can interact with reordered representations; conclusions are conditional on this frozen optimizer/architecture.
Canonical content ranks impose an arbitrary inductive bias from encoded IDs; randomization can regularize. Capacity is matched but optimization difficulty and runtime need measurement.
Eval shuffle uses independently drawn per-row patterns repeated across equally sized batches. It is a fixed treatment seed, not an average over independent evaluation permutations.
Single-seed noise, floating-point reduction differences, arbitrary category-ID order and insufficient adaptation in one training pass can alter AUC.

Two visible successful trajectories are available; failed/abandoned parent-arm outcomes are not imported. Their absence is a knowledge limitation, not proof that those alternatives succeeded or failed.
